scope: Actual retail TH14 setter dispatch and complete 4230d0 movement. Compares four movement records, flags, four scalar interpolation bands, two Vec3 position bands and their clocks. Includes 400/402 position, 404/406/428/430 angle/speed, 416/417 displacement, 424 mirror; scalar angle/speed interpolation, constant-velocity and selected circular/ellipse movement, camera displacement, clamp and visibility. Scalar 409/411 request setup is included here; full paired radius consumption has its separate orbit report. ANM lookup and argument getters are controlled. 700/701 slot writes and 601 emission position/descriptor are checked. 702/703/711/713 native factories are recorded boundaries; the canonical fixture deliberately lacks LaserManager and returns -2 after constructing the byte-identical request. Actual laser consumers have separate reports. Mode 4 is additionally checked with zero initial phase/anchor; separately seeded fields and interpolator interaction are covered by the wave report. Separate angle/ellipse interpolation bands remain outside this check. ECL 713 kind-3 request at 428e6a is checked byte-for-byte, including explicit object id argument and its distinct 0x3c body offset. ECL 711 request setup at 429014 is additionally checked, with missing downstream manager explicitly rejected by the fixture; the real kind-2 consumer is covered by separate curve-laser reports. Also checks ECL 425/426/427 Hermite position setup, tangent pairs and selected negative/zero/positive durations through actual 4261c6 and 4230d0. 420/422 six-argument ellipse setters and mode-3/4 movement frames are additionally verified. ECL 703 copies the full 0x374-byte kind-1 request to native 43a750, including warning/expansion/active/shrink durations, sounds, sprite/color, position/offset, angular velocity and transform body. This proof covers request construction; the kind-1 consumer has its separate laser-infinite report. ECL 412/413 random-direction setup and selected mode 0/4/7/17/18..31 and -1/80 default frame timelines include shared RNG seed/calls, player-side and clamp-quarter tests; speed interpolation mode retention follows the retail store. Also verifies 401/403 Vec3 position interpolation in modes 0..31 and -1/80 defaults, sentinel endpoints, completion and resumed velocity, plus 440/442 angle, 444/446 speed, 441/443 angle interpolation. Modes 18..31 now use the original sine/reverse-parabola easing table through the complete enemy movement path; angle/speed interpolation also covers -1/80 defaults.
